sources.statement: Dot cloud, local computer, and delegated cloud tasks are separate environments. One personal computer connection is documented.
Dots can delegate and follow up. Codex Cloud requires a prepared environment. Fixed-time work needs a saved schedule.
Task stopping, Dot pause, and saved schedule controls are distinct.
Canonical sidebar, naming, and lifecycle rules live in codex-config.

tools.use: Read native projects and chats. Delegate normal coding locally.
Inspect exact repository revisions, checks, reviews, and releases.
Read academic sources and preserve editable artifacts.
Coordinate assigned deadlines and events after reading provider records.
Read assigned coordination. Send only with explicit authority.
Discover tools when the responsibility needs them.

probes.prompt: Inspect your own cloud computer using read-only commands. Report OS, shell, working directory, Node and Python versions. Fetch https://example.com through browser and shell separately when available. Do not install software or dump environment variables.
probes.evidence: Executor identity, exact command output, browser result, shell networking result, and limitations.

probes.prompt: Create one harmless temporary file containing nonce {{nonce}}. Return its exact path and SHA-256. In a later turn, read that file without recreating it and return the hash. Do not create a service or schedule.
probes.evidence: Matching bytes and hash across separate turns. This establishes only observed persistence.

probes.prompt: Read native discovery to find the owner-supplied known Codex task and ChatGPT conversation. Return exact IDs, location, last visible status, retrieval source, requested scope, and missing records. Do not send messages or start tasks.
probes.evidence: Held-out native inventory comparison with coverage gaps and timestamps.

probes.prompt: In the owner-supplied scratch repository on the designated connected Mac, create a read-only local Codex task to return directory, commit, and probe.txt digest. Create a local Work task to summarize that file. Return identities and locations. On explicit owner follow-up, send nonce {{nonce}} to the same Codex chat.
probes.evidence: Native task links, exact executor readbacks, same-chat continuation, and failed-host recovery.

probes.prompt: Start one cloud Work thread to summarize https://example.com. If the owner supplies an already prepared Codex Cloud environment, start a read-only task there to return commit and test command. Do not configure environments. Return distinct identities and locations.
probes.evidence: Visible cloud task records and correct prepared environment identity.

probes.prompt: On the connected computer, read the owner-supplied Emmy verification SKILL.md and run its documented doctor command. Return loaded path, command, commit, stdout, and exit code. Do not install plugins. State unavailable cloud steps.
probes.evidence: Actual local verifier output and explicit cloud boundary.

probes.prompt: Keep responsibility for one check. Pause and choose a follow-up within about ten minutes, then report nonce {{nonce}} here. Do not schedule recurring work or contact others. State if a saved trigger is required.
probes.evidence: Unsolicited later result with timestamps and Activity record. A promise is insufficient.

probes.prompt: After the owner supplies a future absolute time in Asia/Singapore, save one harmless one-time check reporting nonce {{nonce}} in this Dot conversation. Read back identifier, timezone, destination, and enabled state. Afterward inspect the actual run. Do not create recurrence.
probes.evidence: Saved Scheduled fields, later run record, notification observation, and test-trigger cleanup.
